back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,
“Son of man, make Jerusalem know her abominations,
and say, the Lord GOD says this to Jerusalem: Your origin and your birth were in the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
On the day you were born, your navel cord was not cut, you were not washed with water to make you clean, you were not rubbed with salt, and you were not wrapped in cloths.
No eye pitied you enough to do even one of these things for you out of compassion; instead you were thrown out into the open field, because on the day you were born you were despised.
When I passed by and saw you struggling in your blood, I said to you as you lay in your blood, ‘Live!’ I said to you, ‘Live!’
I made you flourish like a plant of the field; you grew up into a beautiful young woman; your breasts were formed and your hair grew long, but you were still naked and bare.

When I passed by and saw you again, behold, you were old enough for love. So I spread the skirt of My garment over you and covered your nakedness; I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you, and you became Mine, declares the Lord GOD.
Then I bathed you with water, washed the blood off you, and anointed you with oil.
I clothed you with embroidered cloth, put fine leather sandals on you, wrapped your waist in fine linen, and covered you with silk.
I adorned you with jewelry, put bracelets on your wrists and a necklace around your neck.
I put a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

So you were adorned with gold and silver; your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth; you ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you advanced to become a queen.
Your fame spread among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect through the splendor I had bestowed on you, declares the Lord GOD.
But you trusted in your beauty and, relying on your fame, played the harlot; you lavished your favors on everyone who passed by, and your beauty became theirs.
You took some of your garments and made for yourself colorful high places, and on them you played the harlot. Such things should not happen, and should never be.
You took the beautiful jewelry of gold and silver that I gave you and made for yourself male idols, and you played the harlot with them.
You took your embroidered garments to cover them, and you set My oil and incense before them.
And the food I gave you—fine flour, oil, and honey that I fed you—you set before them as a pleasing aroma. That is what happened, declares the Lord GOD.
Moreover, you took your sons and daughters whom you bore to Me and sacrificed them to idols as food. Was your harlotry too small a thing?
You slaughtered My children and gave them up, making them pass through the fire to idols.
In all your abominations and harlotries you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, struggling in your blood.
After all your wickedness—woe, woe to you, declares the Lord GOD—
you built yourself a mound and made yourself a lofty platform in every public square.
At the head of every street you built your lofty platform and made your beauty an abomination, and you spread your legs to everyone who passed by, multiplying your harlotry.
You played the harlot with the Egyptians, your lustful neighbors, and increased your harlotry to provoke Me to anger.
Therefore I stretched out My hand against you and reduced your portion; I gave you over to the desire of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd conduct.
You also played the harlot with the Assyrians, because you were never satisfied; you played the harlot with them, yet you were still not satisfied.
You multiplied your harlotry as far as the land of merchants, Chaldea, but even with this you were not satisfied.
How weak is your heart, declares the Lord GOD, that you do all these things, the deeds of a shameless prostitute!
When you built your mounds at the head of every street and made your lofty platforms in every square, you were not even like a prostitute, because you scorned payment.
You adulterous wife, who receives strangers instead of her own husband!
People give gifts to all prostitutes, but you gave gifts to all your lovers, bribing them to come to you from every side for your harlotry.
So in your harlotry you are the opposite of other women: no one solicited you for harlotry; rather, you paid the fee, and no one paid you. So you are the very opposite.
Therefore, O prostitute, hear the word of the LORD.

The Lord GOD says this: Because you poured out your lust and exposed your nakedness in your harlotry with your lovers and with all your detestable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them,

therefore, behold, I will gather all your lovers with whom you took pleasure, all those you loved and all those you hated; I will gather them against you from every side and expose your nakedness to them, so they see all your nakedness.
I will judge you as women who commit adultery and shed blood are judged, and I will bring upon you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
I will give you into their hands; they will tear down your mounds and demolish your lofty platforms, strip off your clothes, take your fine jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
They will bring a mob against you, stone you with stones, and cut you to pieces with their swords.
They will burn your houses with fire and execute judgments against you in the sight of many women. I will make you stop playing the harlot, and you will no longer pay your lovers.
Then I will spend My wrath against you to the full, and My jealousy will turn away from you; I will be calm and no longer angry.

Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged Me with all these things, behold, I will bring your conduct down upon your own head, declares the Lord GOD. Have you not added lewdness to all your abominations?
Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will say of you, ‘Like mother, like daughter.’

You are the daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
Your older sister was Samaria, who lived with her daughters to your north; and your younger sister was Sodom, who lived with her daughters to your south.
You not only walked in their ways and practiced their abominations, but soon you became more corrupt than they in all your ways.
As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, your sister Sodom and her daughters never did as you and your daughters have done.
Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: she and her daughters had pride, surfeit of food, and untroubled ease, but did not reach out a hand to help the poor and needy.
They were haughty and committed abominations before Me; therefore I removed them, as you have seen.
Samaria did not commit half your sins; you multiplied your abominations beyond theirs, making your sisters appear righteous by all the abominations you committed.

So you too must bear your shame, since you made your sisters appear righteous; because your sins were more abominable than theirs, they appear more righteous than you. So you too be ashamed and bear your disgrace, since you made your sisters appear righteous.
But I will restore Sodom and her daughters, and Samaria and her daughters, to their former state, and I will restore you along with them,
so that you bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you did, which became a comfort to them.
Your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to their former state, and you and your daughters will also return to your former state.
In the day of your pride, did you not speak scornfully of your sister Sodom,

before your wickedness was exposed? Now you have become an object of scorn to the daughters of Aram and all those around her, and to the daughters of the Philistines—all those around you who despise you.
You must bear the consequences of your lewdness and your abominations, declares the LORD.
For the Lord GOD says this: I will deal with you according to what you have done, you who despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your older and younger sisters; I will give them to you as daughters, but not because of My covenant with you.
I will establish My covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD,
so that when I make atonement for you for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your disgrace, declares the Lord GOD.”
